lead.t: Acute bacterial meningitis: Life-threatening acute purulent infection of the leptomeninges (pia mater, arachnoid mater) and the subarachnoid space, characterized by meningism and neutrophilic CSF pleocytosis.

snip.t: Acute bacterial meningitis: Life-threatening acute purulent infection of the leptomeninges (pia mater, arachnoid mater) and the subarachnoid space, characterized by meningism and neutrophilic CSF pleocytosis.
Meninges (superficial → deep): Dura mater → Arachnoid mater → Pia mater (Dura is most superficial — frequently tested trap).
snip.s: Cranial Nerves, Eye Exam & Vital Signs: MBChB Clinical Revision — Notes

snip.t: The Meninges: Dura mater (outer, tough fibrous layer), arachnoid mater (avascular middle mesh), and pia mater (vascular inner layer adherent to brain surface).
